description:
Pay {0} to activate Outrider en-Kor, targeting Angelic Protector.
Angelic Protector triggers, giving itself +0/+3 untill end of turn.
Repeat steps 1-2 untill Angelic Protector has infinite toughness.
Pay {W} to cast Worthy Cause, sacrificing Angelic Protector and gaining life equal to its toughness.
